query:
UPDATE brouillon
        SET journal_id = $4, date_comptable = $5, date_valeur_comptable = $6, libelle = $7,
            version = version + 1, modifie_par = $8, modifie_le = $9,
            version_parametres = $10
        WHERE cabinet_id = $1 AND dossier_id = $2 AND id = $3
        RETURNING version
